channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Chivalware
item.description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

item.title: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
item.description: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and improve your character.

item.title: For The King: Lost Civilization Adventure Pack
item.description: Explore the mysterious Jungle Falls and uncover the secrets of an ancient civilization in this thrilling adventure pack. Includes the new jungle realm, arena battles, wands and dual wielding, two new playable characters, and tons of unique enemies and loot.

item.title: Piano Glow
item.description: Piano in online multiplayer lobbies, with leaderboards, gamified training modes (ear, sheet, rhythm, 4K/7K and falling notes). Play any song using either a QWERTY computer/laptop keyboard or a piano. Convert any piano video or sheet music into falling notes tutorial/MIDI.

item.title: PIX Football Manager
item.description: An online football manager. Scout talent from 350+ clubs, trust your eye to find the right players, and outbid rival managers in auctions. Build squad chemistry, shape your tactics, and face other managers’ clubs in weekly leagues, on your own schedule.

item.title: ZED ZONE
item.description: A great catastrophe has struck. While on a mission, your aircraft crashes and you are trapped in the Zed Zone. Zombies and monsters are everywhere. To escape, gather materials, upgrade your skills, build shelters, and defeat zombie hordes and mysterious mechs as you chase a glimmer of hope.

item.title: Crusader: No Regret™
item.description: You’re a renegade Silencer out to settle a score with the powerful World Economic Consortium. Only your instincts, agility and firepower can get you in one piece to the ultimate confrontation with your greatest enemy.

item.title: Crusader: No Remorse™
item.description: If you don't have a bad attitude... you don't have a chance. No pity... No mercy... No Remorse.

item.title: PAYDAY 3: Boys in Blue Weapon Pack
item.description: The Boys in Blue Weapon Pack contains three powerful new weapons brimming with mods to even out the heister's arsenal.

item.title: PAYDAY 3: Fear & Greed Weapon Pack
item.description: The Fear & Greed Weapon Pack expands the heister's arsenal with three high-caliber firearms, each able to blow a silver dollar-sized hole in any target.

item.title: PAYDAY 3: Houston Breakout Weapon Pack
item.description: The Houston Breakout Weapon contains three burstfire weapons complete with mods that will perfectly perforate any foes.

item.title: PAYDAY 3: Syntax Error Weapon Pack
item.description: This pack contains a brand new SMG, Shotgun and Marksman Rifle for heisters looking to expand their repertoir of weapons.

item.title: Swarmslam
item.description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

item.title: Airframe Ultra
item.description: Airframe Ultra is an online, multiplayer combat racing game. There's only two types of racers in Megacity West: The winners and the dead. Down here, you’ve got a chop shop Airframe, a rusted machete, and blood on the motorway. Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing!

item.title: Axis & Allies 1942 Online
item.description: Play the classic board game, Axis & Allies 1942 2nd Edition! Act as WWII powers in a turn-based strategy game that fits your screen and schedule— get notified on your turn and command armies at your own pace! Team up with friends, challenge the world’s top players, or go solo vs. A.I.

item.title: Cash is King! Business Simulator
item.description: Start with nothing and build your own business empire in sunny Miami Beach! Sell lemonade, run vending machines, automate your companies and turn small side jobs into big profits in this relaxed first-person simulator.

item.title: Clean Start
item.description: Clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering emotional stories through the objects you find. Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.

item.title: Company of Heroes 3: Dare & Destroy
item.description: This content requires the base game Company of Heroes 3 on Steam in order to play.

item.title: County of Fortune
item.description: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

item.title: Dungeons of Hinterberg
item.description: Discover the magic and lore of the Alps in this acclaimed Action Adventure. Forge relationships with locals to help you solve puzzles, battle monsters and uncover secrets of the legendary Dungeons of Hinterberg!

item.title: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
item.description: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

item.title: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
item.description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

item.title: Insider Trading
item.description: Insider Trading is a roguelike deckbuilder where you bend the market to your will. Synergize perks, manipulate stock prices, and trade wisely or risk pricing yourself out.

item.title: Meadgard
item.description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends create the ultimate Viking tavern. Hunt mystical beasts by day, cook and serve rowdy patrons by night, and survive the wrath of Norse gods when the mead stops flowing.

item.title: PAYDAY 3: Jacket Character Pack
item.description: Take a swing at crime with the Jacket Character Pack. A Payday Gang veteran, Jacket brings with him his weapons of choice, his chicken mask, a recorder and an unrivaled enthusiasm for violence.

item.title: PAYDAY 3: Swedish Weapon Pack
item.description: Four Swedish forces of destruction are at your fingertips. Includes a secondary, primary, OVERKILL weapon, and a throwable.

item.title: Privateer 2: The Darkening: 30th Anniversary Edition
item.description: Privateer 2: The Darkening is a definitive example of PC gaming expression during the mid-1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated community.

item.title: Road Rash™: 30th Anniversary Edition
item.description: Road Rash, the franchise which defined the combat racing genre, returns in the first ever digital version of the game. This 30th Anniversary Edition includes a fully relicensed soundtrack, higher resolution cinematics, up to 60 FPS gameplay, and more.

item.title: Theme Hospital™
item.description: Design, maintain and manage a hi-tech hospital facility, making the most of limited resources and turning cures into cash. Can you balance the books and the bedpans?

item.title: Ultima™ IV: Quest of the Avatar
item.description: Survive this multi-quest fantasy, then begin the final conflict, your quest of the Avatar. The ultimate challenge - the self - awaits…

item.title: Ultima™ I: The First Age of Darkness
item.description: The original Ultima I was a pioneering product that established new standards in fantasy role-playing games. Journey back to the First Era of the Dark Ages and embark on the original quests of the Ultima chronicles.

item.title: Ultima™ II: The Revenge of the Enchantress
item.description: A map of the realm, and the responsibility that goes with it is now yours. Welcome to the realm of adventure. Welcome to the realm of Lord British.

item.title: Ultima™ III: Exodus
item.description: Without further feats of skill, daring, and perseverance, all of your past accomplishments may be lost. You stand up, prepare your armour, and walk to the dimension door. Stepping in, the hunt resumes.

item.title: Ultima™ IX: Ascension
item.description: Featuring the legendary Ultima System of Virtues where moral fiber is more powerful than physical might. Find out if you have what it takes to be the ultimate hero.

item.title: Ultima™ Underworld 1
item.description: You are the Avatar, noblest of heroes. You have beheld many wonders and proved yourself master of many dungeons. But nothing in your experience prepared you for this - the terror-filled passages of Britannia’s underworld.

item.title: Ultima™ Underworld II
item.description: Time is running out, food and water are running low, and an agent of the Guardian is killing off the imprisoned heroes one by one. You hold Britannia’s fate in your hands once again.

item.title: Ultima™ V: Warriors of Destiny
item.description: Now, Britannia’s destiny depends on your ability to discover the fate of Lord British and unseat the merciless Blackthorn.

item.title: Ultima™ VI: The False Prophet
item.description: Uncover the mystery of the Gargoyles in this exciting sixth episode of the award-winning Ultima saga.

item.title: Ultima™ VII: The Complete Edition
item.description: The first chapter in the third book of the award-winning Ultima saga! Includes both Ultima VII: The Black Gate and Ultima VII Part 2: Serpent Isle.

item.title: Ultima™ VIII Gold Edition
item.description: On the world of Pagan, the Guardian’s control is absolute. You must discover how to defeat the ruling Elemental Titans on their own terms. The time has come to bring the battle to the Guardian.

item.title: Uncrashed : FPV Drone Simulator
item.description: Amateur or experienced FPV pilot, learn or improve your skills on Uncrashed, the ultra realistic FPV simulator. Simulate your own FPV drone with settings based on real values and you will have the same feeling as a real flight without the risk of breaking your drone!

item.title: Underkeep
item.description: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear, and explore a fully handcrafted world.

item.title: Wielders of the Essence
item.description: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Cast spells, command troops, and take your town from puddle to paradise. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

item.title: Wing Commander™ II: Vengeance of the Kilrathi: 35th Anniversary Edition
item.description: Wing Commander II pushed the boundaries for storytelling in games upon its release in 1991. Now celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

item.title: Wing Commander™ III: Heart of the Tiger: 30th Anniversary Edition
item.description: Wing Commander III: Heart of the Tiger is one of the most iconic games of the 1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

item.title: Wing Commander™ IV: The Price of Freedom: 30th Anniversary Edition
item.description: Wing Commander IV: The Price of Freedom is one of the most iconic games of the 1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

item.title: Wing Commander™ Prophecy: 30th Anniversary Edition
item.description: Wing Commander: Prophecy includes the base game plus the amazing Secret Ops episodes. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

item.title: Wing Commander™: 35th Anniversary Edition
item.description: Wing Commander defined the space combat genre upon its release in 1990. Now celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

item.title: Wing Commander™: Academy
item.description: As a student at the TCSN Academy, you custom-design and fly unique missions from the CyberSchool’s holographic simulator. Wing Commander Academy is not another cinematic extravaganza - it’s an intense dogfighting marathon.

item.title: Wing Commander™: Armada
item.description: You are the sole commander, responsible for heading up a momentous strike against your enemy's homeland. In Wing Commander Armada, you have the freedom to construct your own universe, your own missions and your own campaign.

item.title: Wing Commander™: Privateer
item.description: In the far reaches of space, you live by no man’s rules but your own. Choose the life of a pirate, merchant or mercenary. It takes more than a pilot to win this game - it takes a Privateer!

item.title: Word Play
item.description: Spell words, pick perks, score points, and survive until the end. Every round is different. How far can you make it?

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.
